items.english: He bore it, thinking it would be clear when this meeting broke up, which would be any moment now. But starting with Takami-san, no one considerately made a move, and to go dully home ahead of the rest would be dull too, so he took the host's wife again for company and talked of his own plot, what till now he had left forgotten. It was nothing he made trade of, particularly, but when talk turned to the plot, whoever he had for his listener, he at times grew so keen he forgot himself, and the spirit came back into him. This, as he had long thought, was his own taste, his pleasure. So,
notes: Okusan taken as the host's wife, the garden-and-children talk partner from p119-p120, not his own wife; rendered as 'the host's wife' to keep the cast clear. Kept the trailing 'So,' to carry the dangling de into the speech in p173.

items.english: "Eggplants, cucumbers, they'll be coming ready from here on, so whenever you have need I'll give you some," he said, covering over his own disagreeable face that would keep turning sullen. And the hand he had till now held back a little he put out three times running to the mochi cakes.

data.say: Drafted p172 to p174 keeping the plot talk dogged and the fee worry underneath.
